✨ We’re feeling extra merry and bright as we get ready for our 4th Annual Christmas Craft Fair at the Garden Centre! ❤️

 Saturday, November 14 | 10 AM–3 PM

Bring your family and friends and kick off the holiday season with us! ❤️ Admission is by donation, and there’s something for everyone to enjoy, including door prizes, festive treats, handmade crafts, homemade goodies, and so much more!

 While you’re here, be sure to wander through our Christmas Store and soak up all the holiday magic!

✨ Check out the vendor list below to see who will be joining us!

❤️ Make a day of it and explore the Summerside Christmas Craft Trail! There are more festive markets happening on Saturday, November 14, so be sure to visit these other wonderful local craft fairs, too! ⤵

 Artisans Christmas Market
 Linkletter Community Centre
⏰ 10 AM–4 PM

 Three Oaks High School Annual Craft Fair
 Three Oaks High School
⏰ Sat 9 AM-7 PM | Sun 9 AM-5 PM 

 Kool Breeze Farms Christmas Market
 Kool Breeze Farms
⏰ 10 AM–3 PM

️ Shop local, support talented artisans, and enjoy a full day of Christmas shopping and holiday cheer! ❤️

 Please note: We are no longer accepting vendor applications.

We can’t wait to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year with you! ❤️

This fall, 95.1 FM CFCY is coming together to help Islanders in need!

Join us for the Island Wide Food Drive, every Tuesday and Thursday, October 20th through November 5th.

95.1 FM CFCY will be live on location collecting food donations for food banks across PEI!

Visit us at The Haunted Mansion, No Frills Charlottetown, Kay’s Wholesale, HBM Summerside, or Summerside Butcher Shop. ‘

Let’s fill the shelves and help feed our Island community!

Oct. 20 – 12p-4p – Connor and Kennedys No Frills in Charlottetown
Oct. 22 – 4p-7p – The Haunted Mansion in Kensington
Oct. 27 – 12p-4p – Summerside Butcher Shop
Oct. 29 – 12p-4p – Kay’s Wholesale and Fresh Market
Nov. 3 – 12p-4p – Browns Volkswagen
Nov. 5 – 12p-4p – HBM Summerside
